description: Markdown table parser corrupts columns and splits cells prematurely when cells contain escaped pipe characters `\|`.
spec_notes: Invariant: Escaped pipes `\|` must be preserved as literal pipe characters within cell contents and not treated as table column delimiters.

repo_files.table_parser.py:
from typing import List
from row import TableRow
from lexer import split_markdown_row

class MarkdownTableParser:
    def parse(self, text: str) -> List[TableRow]:
        lines = [line.strip() for line in text.strip().splitlines() if line.strip()]
        if len(lines) < 2:
            return []

        rows = []
        for line in lines:
            # Ignore separator row like |---|---|
            cleaned = line.replace("|", "").replace(":", "").replace("-", "").strip()
            if not cleaned:
                continue
            cells = split_markdown_row(line)
            rows.append(TableRow(cells=cells))
        return rows

tests.test_table_parser.py:
from table_parser import MarkdownTableParser

def test_simple_table():
    md = "| Header 1 | Header 2 |\n| --- | --- |\n| val1 | val2 |"
    parser = MarkdownTableParser()
    rows = parser.parse(md)
    assert len(rows) == 2
    assert rows[0].cells == ["Header 1", "Header 2"]
    assert rows[1].cells == ["val1", "val2"]

def test_escaped_pipe_in_cell():
    md = "| Syntax | Description |\n| :--- | :--- |\n| a \\| b | Option A or B |"
    parser = MarkdownTableParser()
    rows = parser.parse(md)
    assert len(rows) == 2
    assert rows[1].cells == ["a | b", "Option A or B"]
